component.name: MP3 Tagger
component.summary: Edit audio metadata with LLM-powered lookup

description.p: MP3 Tagger is a native desktop application for editing metadata of MP3, FLAC, OGG, M4A, WAV, AIFF and APE files. It offers list and grid library views, a detail view covering more than 34 metadata fields, embedded album artwork handling and batch adding of files.
Metadata can be filled in automatically through any OpenAI compatible API, so a title and artist are enough to fetch the remaining fields.
